name: Goldene Krone
beschreibung: Hotel Goldene Krone is located in the historic old town of Innsbruck. It is a traditional city hotel with a long gastronomic history. The rooms are modernly furnished and offer contemporary comfort. From here, guests can reach the Goldene Dachl and the Hofburg comfortably on foot. The hotel has a breakfast restaurant and a bar. Public transport and the Nordkettenbahn are also easily accessible.
